desc: The Velocity Tactical Rifle Case from Allen Tactical fits tactical firearms up to 42" or 55" in length. The two extra-large front pockets have stretch slots inside that can be used to organize gear and mags. The third front pocket is 15" x 6" and padded, designed to fit suppressors or other accessories that need extra protection. The Endura exterior fabric is durable and will stand up to use and abuse, and the inside of the case features dual-density heavy-duty padding. Includes heavy-duty web handles with a padded handle grip and a removable, adjustable shoulder sling with a shoulder pad and metal hardware.
